name: Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce
author: Tamjidul Azam

sections.description:
Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce is a lightweight, professional floating cart widget for WooCommerce stores. It displays a beautiful, animated floating cart button that follows your visitors as they browse your site.

Key Features

  • 🎯 Customizable Position – Place your cart in 6 different positions (left/right × top/middle/bottom)
  • 🎨 Custom Icon Upload – Upload your own icon (PNG, JPG, SVG) or use the default cart icon
  • 🔴 Live Cart Count – Real-time cart item counter that updates instantly
  • 🎁 Mini Cart Preview – Beautiful hover effect showing products, prices, and quantities
  • ⚡ Lightweight – Only ~15KB, doesn’t slow down your site
  • 📱 Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices and screen sizes
  • 🔒 Security – Follows WordPress security best practices with sanitization and escaping
  • 🎪 Smooth Animations – Professional hover transitions and effects
  • 💛 WooCommerce Compatible – Works with WooCommerce 3.0+

How It Works

  1. Once activated, a floating cart button appears on your website
  2. The cart displays the current item count in a red badge
  3. When visitors hover over the cart, a mini cart preview slides out
  4. They can see all products, prices, remove items, or go to checkout
  5. The cart count updates automatically as items are added/removed

Admin Settings

Control everything from WordPress admin:
* Enable/Disable – Turn the floating cart on or off
* Horizontal Position – Choose Left or Right side
* Vertical Position – Choose Top, Middle, or Bottom
* Icon Source – Use default cart icon or upload custom icon
* Icon Color – Pick any color for the default icon
* Icon Upload – Upload PNG, JPG, or SVG icons (recommended: 80×80px)

Technical Details

  • Language: PHP 7.2+ with WordPress hooks and filters
  • CSS: Custom CSS with smooth animations and responsive design
  • JavaScript: jQuery-based with AJAX for real-time updates
  • Database: Uses WordPress options table (no custom tables)
  • Performance: Minimal footprint, no external dependencies
  • Security: Input sanitization, output escaping, nonces for AJAX

Developer Information

Developed by: Tamjidul Azam
Website: https://www.linkedin.com/in/meshimul
Support: Get in touch with me for additional support

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • jQuery (included with WordPress)

Configuration

After activation:

  1. Go to WordPress Admin → Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce
  2. Check Enable Floating Cart
  3. Choose Horizontal Position (Left or Right)
  4. Choose Vertical Position (Top, Middle, or Bottom)
  5. Select Icon Source:
    • Default: Use the built-in shopping cart icon
    • Custom: Upload your own icon (PNG, JPG, SVG)
  6. If using default icon, choose Icon Color
  7. Click Save Settings

That’s it! Your floating cart is now live on your website.

Support

For support, documentation, and updates, visit:
https://www.techbaksho.com

License

Credits

Website: https://www.techbaksho.com

Thank you for using Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce! We hope it helps improve your WooCommerce store experience.
sections.installation:
Method 1: From WordPress Plugin Directory

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Click Activate
  5. Go to Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce menu to configure

Method 2: Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate
  5. Go to Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce menu to configure

Method 3: Via FTP

  1. Unzip the plugin file
  2. Upload the cart-baksho folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin from Plugins menu
  4. Go to Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce to configure
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my website?

No. Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce is highly optimized and only adds ~15KB of CSS and JavaScript to your site. It has no external dependencies.

Can I customize the colors and positioning?

Yes! The admin panel gives you full control over positioning, icon color (for default icon), and icon choice.

Does it work with custom WooCommerce themes?

Yes! Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce is compatible with all WooCommerce themes and uses standard WordPress and WooCommerce functions.

Can I upload a custom icon?

Yes! You can upload PNG, JPG, or SVG icons. We recommend square icons at 80×80 pixels for best results.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce is fully responsive and works perfectly on phones, tablets, and desktops.

Can I change the cart count badge color?

Yes! You can edit the CSS file to customize colors. By default, it uses a red badge (#ff5252).

Will my settings be saved if I deactivate the plugin?

Yes! Your settings are stored in the WordPress database. They will remain even if you deactivate the plugin. They will only be deleted if you remove (delete) the plugin entirely.

Is it compatible with cache plugins?

Yes, Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce uses AJAX for real-time updates, so it works correctly even with caching plugins.

What payment methods does it support?

Baksho Floating Cart for WooCommerce works with all payment methods supported by your WooCommerce store. It simply displays the cart and links to the checkout page.
